move: cards rise into a fanned stack, front card lifts and cycles back
how: Headline and subline rise out of masks with expo.out. Four credit cards from() y:500 rotationX:-30 with slight fan rotation and move (negative stagger so the back card leads), then at 0.14D settle into an offset stack (each slot y -34k, x 18k, rotation -3k, scale 1-0.02k, expo.inOut). From 0.24D, every 1.75s, the front card lifts y:-150 with rotation -6 and rotationY 35 (move 0.55s), its zIndex drops behind, and it glides into the back slot with expo.inOut while the other three shift forward one slot; the tier label list highlights the matching name with a small x nudge. After four cycles the order returns to the start, so the stack at the end matches the settled stack (no exit).
adapt: Replace card colours/gradients, brand, masked numbers, tier names and the headline/subline; card count changes the cycle count and slot offsets. Keep the 1.75s cycle cadence and the lift/tilt eases.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .h1, .sub, .tier and a .deck of .card elements from shot.cards; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with cycle t = (2.4 + i*1.75)/10 * D and slot() offsets. The container needs perspective:1600px; scope selectors to el and keep the zIndex sets on the timeline.
caveats: headline and cards stay on screen at the end; the loop cuts from the settled stack back to the empty first frame
zIndex changes via tl.set; scrubbing backwards depends on GSAP restoring them
